subject: How to install R package in Non-interactive way

messages.author: 9d042f463d42ef40
messages.subject: How to install R package in Non-interactive way
parts:
Hi Guys,

I am new to Rhadoop. How to install R package non-interactive way to machine. We have 50 machine cluster. we need install any R packages means login each and every machine install package.
any way to that non interactive way.

For example:
R
> install.packages('car') select mirror and install process starts.

install.packages(c("tseries","urca","vars","HH","tsDyn","car","gplots","TTR","gtools"), repos="http://cran.r-project.org" )

like help of bash script

please guide me.

-Dhanasekaran

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#789] How to install R package in Non-interactive way
parts:
Please take a look in the source package under tools/whirr, there is a script that may get you started. Unsupported and a little out of date and tested in a very specific environment, so please take it only as a starting point for your own script.

Antonio

messages.author: e63f32a7ce6b8890
messages.subject: Re: How to install R package in Non-interactive way
parts:
Hi Dhanasekaran,

This should do what you need:

echo 'install.packages(c("tseries","urca","vars","HH","tsDyn","car","gplots","TTR","gtools"), repos="http://cran.r-project.org" )' | R --no-save

-Carlos
